body.message: Good morning! For Elite Business Bay, we currently have a 2BR available at AED 5,500/month all-inclusive, but no studio or 1BR there right now. Nearby in Business Bay, there's a studio in MAG 318 at AED 5,300/month or a 1BR in Urban Oasis at AED 5,500/month. Would you like to take a look at either of those?
